name: Infyicon – SVG & PNG Icons
author: infyicon

sections.description:
Infyicon puts a library of 160,000+ free icons inside WordPress:

  • Infyicon Icon block — in the block editor, add the “Infyicon Icon” block, search by keyword, filter by style (outline, filled, color outline, color filled) and click an icon. It is downloaded once into your Media Library and inserted as a regular image.
  • Media → Infyicon Icons — a full browser with search and infinite scroll. Click any icon and add it to your Media Library, then use it anywhere: Classic editor, Elementor, widgets, featured images and so on. A “Copy SVG code” button is there for theme developers.

Performance-first by design. The icon file is fetched a single time, when you pick it. Your visitors are always served the image from your own site (or your CDN) — this plugin adds no external requests, no scripts and no styles to your site’s front end. Nothing loads from infyicon.com on public pages.

Icons come in four matching styles so your designs stay consistent, with new icons added continuously.

License for the icons: free to use with attribution to infyicon.com — see the license. The plugin code itself is GPLv2 or later.

External service

This plugin talks to the infyicon.com API only from your WP admin, and only when you act: search queries you type are sent to https://infyicon.com/api/search, and when you pick an icon its image file is downloaded from https://infyicon.com. No other data is transmitted, nothing is sent from your visitors’ browsers, and no tracking is involved. See the privacy policy and terms.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. In any post or page, add the Infyicon Icon block, search, click an icon — done.
  3. Or go to Media → Infyicon Icons to add icons straight to your Media Library.

No account, no API key, no settings.
sections.faq:
Do the icons load from infyicon.com on my site?

No. Every icon you pick is saved into your own Media Library and served from your site like any other image. The infyicon.com API is only contacted from the admin, when you search or insert.

What format are inserted icons?

Transparent 512×512 PNG — crisp at any normal display size and accepted by every WordPress setup without extra configuration. SVG code for any icon can be copied from Media → Infyicon Icons.

Are the icons really free?

Yes — free with attribution to infyicon.com, as described at https://infyicon.com/license.

Does it work with Elementor / Classic editor / any page builder?

Yes. Add icons via Media → Infyicon Icons; they land in your Media Library, which every builder can use.
